description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Dispute between Mr. Senaka Maithri de Livera,Kotte vs Royal Colombo Golf Club of Nine (09) Persous (Award).
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an industrial dispute arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, an arbitrator's decision, and references to specific sections of legislation (Chapter 131). The content focuses on regulatory compliance and legal enforcement of labor laws, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure issue or any other specialized category.
